# Linear Templates

This directory contains markdown templates for Linear issues.

## Usage

1. Open Linear.
2. Go to **Settings** > **Team** > **Templates**.
3. Create a new template or edit the default one.
4. Copy the content of the markdown file (e.g., `linear-task.md`).
5. Paste it into the Linear template editor.
6. Save the template.

## Available Templates

- [Task Template](./linear-task.md): Standard template for feature development, enhancements, and other tasks.
